state_prefix.source_representation: The existing canonical src/eng1/behavioral/viewport_state_data.c provider owns one byte array of exactly 0x1c; the private 32bd0 build reuses it rather than defining a duplicate. state_prefix.other_references: The indexed module has additional memory references within this prefix from other routines; they are outside this two-root candidate and require separate behavioral ownership review.

upload_descriptor.consumer: 0x32ba5 pushes the address 0x1005df00 as arg1 to 0x2c7f0; the other argument is the allocation pointer.
upload_descriptor.source_representation: The existing canonical src/eng1/behavioral/viewport_state_data.c provider supplies four initialized 16-bit values. Exact contents and pointer target are supported; the original declaration, source unit, storage class, and placement are not.
upload_descriptor.neighbor_limit: The existing profile-row view begins at 0x5df08. The descriptor is kept independent; no pointer-before-object or adjacency claim is made.

coordinate_lookup.row_view: 192 complete two-byte pairs in the measured prefix
coordinate_lookup.boundary_evidence: The measured prefix ends at 0x5df00, which is the separate eight-byte descriptor target used by 0x32b10. The bytes through 0x5deff form 192 complete coordinate pairs; the source does not claim an original C declaration or any table extent beyond this measured prefix.
coordinate_lookup.bounded_access: The private candidate checks row < 192 before either the table read or cache write. For an unsupported row it reports a noncontinuable incomplete behavior at 0x32bd0 with the measured-prefix reason; this is an explicit candidate limit, not a claim about native out-of-range behavior. The in-prefix path retains the observed cache-before-table-read/callback order.

color_state_prefix.initialization_evidence: The interval is beyond the .data raw end 0x6e800 and before its virtual end 0x74658; the PE loader zero-fills it.

access_views.consumer: 0x32bd0 writes the repeated first interpolated color; 0x33420 reads it as the first color DWORD.
0x32bd0 writes the repeated second interpolated color; 0x33420 reads it as the second color DWORD.
0x32bd0 writes a WORD and then reads a DWORD, masking its low WORD; 0x33420 also reads/tests the low WORD.

color_state_prefix.source_representation: One twelve-byte private zero-fill prefix makes the observed byte offsets and access widths coherent; it does not assert an original aggregate or extend through the distinct observed cells beginning at 0x6ffd8.
color_state_prefix.other_references: The only code consumers in this bounded graph are 0x32bd0 and helper 0x33420; references at 0x6ffd8 and later remain outside this prefix.

stack_proof.blend_flags: 334f9 reload clears EDI upper16;33504 MOVZX DI,BYTE makes EDI low8(arg4). AND200 then OR60 and multiply4 writes180 to reused arg6 slot3355e. 335b7 reload observes180, so packet WORD+16 is1a0/1c0.
